findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
Observed a box of plastic cups stored directly on the ground. An employee moved the plastic cups off the ground during the inspection. Ensure all single-use articles are stored at least 6-inches off the ground. 

4-903.11: (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
The standing cooler was cold holding foods at about 51F (ambient air of a probe thermometer left inside the cooler). The temperature issue could have been caused by large boxes stored on the top shelf by the fan. The TCS foods were moved into the prep cooler bottom. The PIC was instructed to closely monitor the temperature of the cooler (and call for service if needed). This is the last time the food truck is operating in Sangamon County for the year so there will not be a follow-up.

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source
findings.comment:
Observed potato salad prepared in a home kitchen being served. The inspector educated the PIC that they CANNOT serve foods made in a home kitchen. All foods must be prepared in the food truck. The PIC and employees were instructed to NOT serve the potato salad.

3-201.11: (A)-(B) FOOD shall be obtained from APPROVED source and not from private home. P (C) PACKAGED Food shall be properly labeled. (E) WHOLE-MUSCLE BEEF shall be from approved source and acceptable from AUTHROITY. Pf (D) FISH must be frozen if consumed undercooked. (F) Meat and Poultry shall be properly labeled. (G) Eggs shall be properly labeled. C
